central_thesis: Learned bounded interpolation after Tensor-OMP support selection is a lower-compute amortized refinement with separate CDL robustness evidence; matched NOMP-inspired recovery dominates accuracy, and the scalar, CDL-controller, and depth-diagnostic paths remain distinct.

claims.claim: Joint channel and target estimation is represented as sparse angle-delay-Doppler tensor recovery in the evaluated FDMA virtual-array regime.
must_not_claim: The formulation alone proves identifiability or external performance.

claims.claim: A one-parameter bounded interpolation scale improves local measurement-domain NMSE over grid Tensor-OMP.
claims.scope: Synthetic 128x16x32 tensor, SNR=20 dB, L={2,4,8}, five seeds, two train and 30 test scenes per L and seed.

claims.claim: A separate 210-parameter feature-conditioned controller improves aggregate channel, delay, and projected-angle metrics on held-out CDL-A/C seeds.
claims.scope: CDL-A/C, 64x4 observation, SNR={0,10,20,30} dB, L={4,8,16}, five held-out seeds, 50 samples per profile and seed; CDL-D is zero-shot boundary evidence.

claims.claim: A deterministic plateau gate provides a restricted high-load depth-saving trade-off at 20 dB, but the same statistic is not stable across SNR.
claims.scope: Synthetic 128x16x32 tensor; positive claim only for L>=32 at 20 dB; five seeds and five test scenes per cell.

claims.claim: A paper-scale matched comparison places NOMP-inspired recovery at the accuracy-oriented end and the learned scalar at a lower-compute point.
claims.scope: Known-order dense sinusoidal tensors, SNR={0,10,20,30} dB, L={2,4,8}, five seeds, 20 paired scenes per cell.

writing_blockers: A unified executable multi-stage learned estimator is absent; retain the post-support-refinement title and identity until E11 is complete.
Author names, affiliations, funding acknowledgments, and the final target-journal metadata remain placeholders.
Trained DeepMIMO physical delay/angle evaluation and instrumented-receiver validation remain open.
